subject: Other Corridors Zoning Proposal
overview: The Community Development Board and city planning staff held a public Q&A session to present and receive feedback on proposed mixed-use and residential zoning changes along several major city corridors.

items.title: Introduction and Zoning Process Overview
items.summary: Councilor Kit Collins and Planning Director Alicia Hunt introduced the session, outlining how the corridor proposals fit into Medford's ongoing citywide rezoning process.

items.title: Corridors Zoning Proposal Presentation
items.summary: Zoning consultant Emily Innes detailed the proposed dimensional changes, mixed-use sub-districts, and environmental standards for corridors including Boston Avenue, Main Street, and High Street.

items.title: Public Q&A Session
items.summary: Residents and board members discussed the details of the proposals, including shadow impacts, utility infrastructure capacity, coordination with Tufts University, and the preservation of neighborhood character.
